title: Productive sets and complete enumerable problems

based_on.title: Simple sets
based_on.pages: PDF pp. 6–7 (productive sets contain infinite enumerable subsets; lecture slides, 2023-10-18)

summary: Find effective escape points from enumerable subsets, characterize complete enumerable sets by creativity, and build an infinite enumerable subset of every productive set.
abstract: Suppose a program recognizes only some members of a set. Can another algorithm use that program’s index to find a member it misses, whenever everything recognized really belongs to the set? A set with such a total escape algorithm is called productive. It cannot itself be computably enumerable, yet iterating the escape rule constructs an infinite enumerable subset inside it. When the complement of an enumerable set is productive, the original set is called creative. These are exactly the enumerable sets to which every enumerable membership problem can be translated by a total computable map preserving both answers.
